items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I love Sam Rivers. Sam Rivers played some things that, you know, harmonically...

ctx.x: I mean has there been someone after Ornette that stands out that has been a real kind of pioneer?

I really can’t think of nobody else done that. I love Sam Rivers. Sam Rivers played some things that, you know, harmonically, Sam Rivers, Ornette, I don’t know, man. There’s a whole lot of young people that’s done things but I haven’t come to nobody. Well say like really, I can go back to Monk and all that, there isn’t anybody really. Monk did some things that people still have to, you know I mean when he was playing Bebop I mean there’s some things that Monk played that still is amazing to me, how he could do…
